domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTkZnXtRhuEiiyidvJ

Area ruling on premise 1 (option C, measure first): unreachable on a real boot, so no runtime change. The os-dev-report above measured the showcase dev boot over HTTP in four cells: a managed package's name refuses a package-less save (403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) or leaves an earlier row sealed and unserved after an upgrade (`metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved`, ADR-0131 D6); a runtime-authored package's name keeps the row in the engine registry, where the holder's route judges the holder's declaration; a package-less save of a name one writable package holds is re-addressed into it. Only the #32681 harness composes the shape. PR #33898 now reads `Fixes #33456` (body patched through the relay), so this card closes when it merges. The listing gap (`getMetaItems` action listing omits the package-less row on the other object, now with HTTP reach) goes to the seat for a card.
